original_target.title: Polynomial-time Bernoulli group testing at the information threshold

scope_comparison: Lovig–Zadik proves low-temperature local Johnson-chain bottleneck/hardness for certain parameters and initializations, not impossibility for all polynomial decoders. The new threshold-query theorem permits chosen design and selectable unbounded thresholds, unlike prescribed iid Bernoulli noiseless OR. Spatial coupling and prior restrictions likewise change the target.
